recent_changes.description: C1: Refactored ScriptWriter.tsx from 1040 to ~500 lines. Extracted constants.ts, utils/audioUtils.ts, hooks/useAudioPlayer.ts.
H4: Removed duplicate STYLE_LABELS/TONE_LABELS from ResultDisplay.tsx, now imports from shared constants.ts.
H1: Created ErrorBoundary.tsx class component wrapping App in index.tsx. Shows Vietnamese error UI.
H2: Added beforeunload event listener in App.tsx to prevent accidental data loss.
M1: Added SEO meta tags (description, theme-color, OG, Twitter Card) to index.html, changed lang to 'vi'.
M2: Replaced Tailwind CSS CDN with official @tailwindcss/vite plugin. Created index.css with @import 'tailwindcss'.
Installed @types/react and @types/react-dom to fix React 19 class component type errors.
